messages:
sophia: Quick ask — release notes cutoff in ~24h. If you have any PRs landing, please post a one-sentence blurb here + PR link and claim an owner. Need compact summary + component tag. Example below. Trying to avoid a last-minute sweep. :pray:

arjun: Will add mine — PR #4821 (model-routing): tightened fallback policy for microbursts, reduces p99 latency ~8%.

katie: Quick formatting Q — do we still want `component:` prefix or tags in square brackets? I used [runtime] recently.

sophia: Prefer `component: runtime` as per template in docs: https://redwood.dev/release-template. Also put owner handle at end, e.g., `... (PR #1234, @yourname)`.

mike: I'm on PR #4830 (chore): bumping package versions and running prefill. Should I include the bump as a blurb too?

sophia: Yes — include a short blurb for the version bump: `packaging: bump xyz to v1.2.3 (PR #4830, @mike)`.

release-bot: changelog-lint ➜ PR #4830 failed: missing `component:` tag. See CI log: <link-to-ci>

mike: fixing now; adding `component: packaging` and a concise line.

tasha: Claiming PR #4821; I'll trim the blurb and add the ticket link.

arjun: One more style note: prefer present tense, no vague phrasing. e.g., `improves`, `reduces`, `adds`.

katie: Example blurb for reference:
```
model-routing: prefer smaller model variant for latency-sensitive routes (PR #4821, @tasha)
```

sophia: If a change is risky add `hotfix:` or mention regression checklist. Otherwise skip extra fields. Cutoff is 18:00 UTC tomorrow. :calendar:

mike: pushed fix and updated blurb; will report when CI green.

tasha: Blurb uploaded to the changelog file and linked in PR description. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Reminder — cutoff < 24h. For exceptions ping @sophia.
